description: Split a fixed monthly rent across rooms, equally or weighted by room size, and divide a shared room's rent equally between its occupants. Use when deciding who pays how much rent. Do NOT use for utility bills (use split_utilities) or to settle who already paid what (use settle_up).

method.description: 'equal' (same rent per room) or 'by_size' (proportional to size). Default: by_size when every room has a size, else equal

rooms.description: Every room that pays rent (room names must be unique), e.g. [{"name":"Master","size":20,"occupants":["Asha","Dev"]}]

occupants.description: Names of the people in this room; when given, the room's rent is split equally between them

size.description: Room area (m2 or ft2, any consistent unit), positive; needed on every room for by_size

total_rent.description: Monthly rent for the whole home, positive number in any currency, e.g. 2400

name: split_rent

note.description: Plain-language explanation of how the rent was split

rooms.description: Per-room rent shares, in input order; they sum to total_rent

per_occupant.description: Equal split of this room's rent between its occupants (only when occupants were given)

weight.description: Weight used: room size for by_size, 1 for equal

total_rent.description: Total monthly rent that was split, rounded to cents

title: Split rent
